# Djordje Nedovic

> Senior Software Engineer specializing in .NET, Azure cloud architecture, distributed systems and Azure cost optimisation. Based in Novi Sad, Serbia.

## Services

- [Azure Cost Optimisation for .NET Teams](https://djordjenedovic.tech/services): Azure cost assessment, optimisation and governance as code, and application-level cost engineering for .NET workloads.

## Blog

- [One Character That Broke My Terraform Migration](https://djordjenedovic.tech/posts/subscription-rule-migration): Debugging a cryptic AzureRM provider error during Terraform 0.12 → 0.13 migration caused by a $ character in a resource name.
- [Goodbye AutoMapper: Simple Mapping with Extension Methods and Delegates in .NET](https://djordjenedovic.tech/posts/migrate-from-automapper): Replacing AutoMapper with lightweight extension methods and delegates in .NET.
- [How to Set Up a YAML Pipeline for Publishing a NuGet Package](https://djordjenedovic.tech/posts/publish-preview-nuget-package): Step-by-step guide for Azure DevOps YAML pipeline for NuGet packaging.

## About

Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience in .NET, Azure, and distributed systems. Previously at Endava (fintech banking portal) and EXLRT (airline systems). Currently at Combined Ratio Solutions building a greenfield cloud-native platform. Certified AZ-204, AZ-500 and FinOps Certified Practitioner.
